left: The Earth orbits the Sun.
right: the earth   orbits the sun.
note: Case/whitespace variation should be easy for a deterministic normalized baseline, but retrieval still does not grant Canon identity.

left: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius at standard pressure.
right: At standard atmospheric pressure, water becomes ice at 0 °C.
note: Equivalent-looking wording with a material pressure qualifier that must be preserved.

left: The committee postponed the vote until Friday.
right: No ballot will be held before the end of the workweek because the panel delayed it.
note: Useful semantic-recall case with low direct token overlap; temporal interpretation still needs review.

left: The experiment was stopped because the safety limit was exceeded.
right: Эксперимент остановили, потому что был превышен предел безопасности.
note: Cross-lingual candidate where lexical-only retrieval is expected to struggle.

left: Mars has two small moons.
right: Mars has a thin atmosphere dominated by carbon dioxide.
note: Shared entity is not claim identity.

left: Ada Lovelace wrote notes on Babbage's Analytical Engine.
right: Ada Lovelace was born in London.
note: Entity overlap alone must not become a related-claim or identity proof.

left: The treatment reduced mortality in the trial.
right: The treatment did not reduce mortality in the trial.
note: Near-identical lexical form with opposite polarity is a hard false-identity trap.

left: The device prevents data loss during power failure.
right: The device may reduce the risk of data loss during power failure.
note: Modality changes strength; high similarity must not collapse the claims.

left: All participants completed the survey.
right: Most participants completed the survey.
note: Quantifier mismatch can make superficially similar claims incompatible depending on corpus facts.

left: The service supported Python 3.11 in 2024.
right: The service supports Python 3.12 in 2026.
note: Version/time qualifiers prevent identity even with strong topic overlap.

left: The report states that the city is financially stable.
right: The city is financially stable.
note: A source-attribution proposition is not identical to endorsing the embedded proposition.

left: The author quotes the claim that artificial light harms sleep.
right: The author concludes that artificial light harms sleep.
note: Quoted material and author endorsement are distinct proposition types.

left: Birds can fly.
right: Penguins cannot fly.
note: Potential exception/contextualization; a contradiction detector must not automatically select POSSIBLE_CONTRADICTION without scope reasoning.

left: Java supports virtual threads.
right: Java produces a large share of Indonesia's coffee.
note: Same surface token refers to a programming platform vs an island/coffee origin.

left: This report is provided for informational purposes and does not constitute legal advice about tax planning.
right: This report is provided for informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice about cardiac care.
note: Large boilerplate overlap should not dominate claim-level relevance.

left: The alarm triggers when temperature exceeds 80 °C.
right: The alarm triggers when temperature exceeds 90 °C.
note: One changed number is semantically decisive despite almost identical text.

left: The limit is 1000 milligrams per day.
right: The limit is 1 gram per day.
note: Potential equivalence requires unit normalization/review; raw text differs.

left: The filing deadline is 30 days under German procedure.
right: The filing deadline is 30 days under French procedure.
note: Same predicate/value but different jurisdiction blocks identity.

left: The cache is cleared when the user logs out.
right: The cache is cleared when the user logs out if secure mode is enabled.
note: A condition changes scope and prevents automatic identity.

left: Reduced rainfall lowered reservoir levels.
right: Low reservoir levels caused the city to introduce water restrictions.
note: Causal chain relation is useful but neither paraphrase nor identity.
